title: Files drive: asleep snapshot
description: File-name metadata the runtime writes to the user's own R2 bucket so browsing works while a computer sleeps.

SnapshotEncryption.description: Decided (Eoj 2026-11-15): v2 writes none, i.e. plain file names in the user's own R2 bucket, the same trust class as files they upload. files_key_v1 is reserved, not used in v2: XChaCha20-Poly1305 with the snapshot subkey of the user's Files root key (keys.json).

names_encrypted.description: v2 writers always write false (Eoj 2026-11-15: plain names). true is reserved, not used in v2: names would live only in ciphertext, with encryption files_key_v1 and key_id set. A v2 reader that meets true shows the folder as "names unavailable" instead of failing.

ciphertext.description: Reserved, not used in v2. names_encrypted true: base64url XChaCha20-Poly1305 of the roots JSON array.

nonce.description: Reserved, not used in v2. base64url 24-byte nonce.

key_id.description: Reserved, not used in v2. Key reference: the FilesKeyInfo.key_id whose snapshot subkey (HKDF info "files-snapshot/1") sealed this file.

names_encrypted.description: v2 writers always write false (Eoj 2026-11-15: plain names). true is reserved, not used in v2: names would live only in ciphertext, with encryption files_key_v1 and key_id set. A v2 reader that meets true shows the folder as "names unavailable" instead of failing.

ciphertext.description: Reserved, not used in v2. names_encrypted true: base64url XChaCha20-Poly1305 of the items JSON array.
